</p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;">
<b style="color: #333333;"><span style="font-size: 2em;">Fourth Stratagem</span></b></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333;"><b><span style="font-size: x-large;"><br /></span></b></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><b style="color: #333333;"><span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: x-large;"><span lang="zh-CN">以逸待劳</span></span></b></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">(yǐ
yì dài láo)</span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: x-large;"><i>Wait
at Leisure While the Enemy Labors</i></span></p>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">Choosing
when and where a battle takes place can be a great advantage. When
circumstances can be so arranged, the opportunity to cause one's
opponent to needlessly expend energy will often arise.</span></p>

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">In
342 B.C., during the Battle of Maling, the Wei forces had the
advantage over those of Qi in both numbers and morale. Sun Bin
(serving Qi) ordered his men to retreat. Being well positioned and
well-prepared while the Wei pursued them with tiresome haste, Sun Bin
was able to ambush and defeat them [18], [29].</span></p>

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><span><i><span style="font-weight: normal;">Wait
at Leisure While the Enemy Labors</span></i></span> is also
associated with the 41st hexagram, <i>Mountain over Thunder</i>. What
was below has moved upward, weakening what was below. One
interpretation is that a benefit may be got from a loss suffered by
the opponent<span style="text-decoration: none;">
</span><span style="text-decoration: none;">[1],
[28]</span>.</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: large;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: large;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;">


	
	
	
	

</p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;">
<span face="Noto Sans CJK SC Black, sans-serif" style="color: #333333; font-size: x-large;"><b>VOCAB LIST 4:</b></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span>

</p>
<div dir="ltr" id="Section15" style="column-count: 2;"><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #ffa400;"><span style="font-size: large; color: #0047AB !important;">to stay/to await:<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; color: #0047AB !important;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important; lang="zh-CN">等待</span></span>:
	děngdài</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">of
	course: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">当然</span></span>:
	dāngrán   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">and:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">和</span></span>/<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">还有</span></span>/<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">而且</span></span>:
	hé/hái yǒu/érqiě   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">with:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">和</span></span>:
	hé   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">than...
	(e.g. less than...): <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">比</span></span>...:
	bǐ...   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">about
	(approximately): <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">大约</span></span>:
	dàyuē</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">have...(past
	tense, e.g. have eaten): ...<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">过</span></span>:
	...guò</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important; font-size: large;">labor:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span style="color: #0047AB !important; lang="zh-CN">劳动</span></span></span>:
	láodòng</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">to
	seem like: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">像</span></span>/<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">好像</span></span>:
	xiàng/hǎoxiàng   open/close (e.g. a door): <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">开</span></span>/<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">关</span></span>:
	kāi/guān</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">open/close
	(e.g. one’s mouth): <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">张</span></span>/<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">闭</span></span>:
	zhāng/bì   also: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">也</span></span>:
	yě</span></p>
</div>
<br><br>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><a name="tw-source-rmn38"></a>
front/behind/middle (as nouns): <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">前面</span></span></span>/<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">后面</span></span></span>/<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">中间</span></span></span>:
 qiánmiàn/hòumiàn/zhōngjiān</span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">in
front of/behind/in the middle of: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">在</span></span>...<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">前面</span></span>/<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">在</span></span>...<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">后面</span></span>/<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">在</span></span>...<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">间</span></span>:</span></p>
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large !important;">zài...qiánmiàn/zài...hòumiàn/zài...zhōngjiān</span></p>

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">in
front of/behind/in the middle of: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">在</span></span>...<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">的前面</span></span>/<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">在</span></span>...<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">的后面</span></span>/<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">在</span></span>...<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">的中间</span></span>:
</span></p>
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">               
 zài...de qiánmiàn/zài...de hòumiàn/zài...de zhōngjiān</span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span>

</p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span face="Noto Sans CJK SC Black, sans-serif" style="color: #333333; font-size: x-large;"><b>Sample Sentences 4:</b></span></p>

</p>
<div dir="ltr" id="Section60" style="column-count: 2;"><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">1) Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你有没有吃过狗肉？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">A:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">我当然吃过狗肉。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	1) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我很喜欢吃苹果</span></span>,
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">还有香蕉。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: I much like to eat
	apples and bananas.</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	2) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你喜不喜欢吃苹果和香蕉？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span lang="en-US"><span style="text-decoration: none;">5</span></span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span lang="en-US"><span style="text-decoration: none;">)</span></span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"> </span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: times; color: #0047AB !important;">她要他在小店门口等待。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span lang="en-US"><span style="text-decoration: none;">6)</span></span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"> </span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: times; color: #0047AB !important;">她下个星期要劳动。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	3) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">这个对他来说很困难，而且不重要。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	4) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你比他高，也比我高。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: You are taller than
	him, and taller than me.</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	5) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">开这个门似乎很容易。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	6)  <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我应不应该关门？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	7)  <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">闭嘴！</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	8)  <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">张开双手。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	9)  <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">他大约两米高。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	10) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">她在小店前面休息。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	11) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">小店的后面也有门。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	12) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">这个学校在森林的中间。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span face="Noto Sans CJK SC Black, sans-serif" style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span lang="en-US">1</span></span><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span lang="en-US">7</span></span><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span lang="en-US">)</span></span>
	</span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: large;"><span lang="zh-CN">它后面有一棵很高的树，<span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;">
	</span>它前面有一辆</span></span>
    <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">
    &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;车。</span></span></p>
</div>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333;">
